ruleDefinitions.name: Macro Enabled In A Potentially Suspicious Document
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects registry changes to Office trust records where the path is located in a potentially suspicious location

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Security\\\\Trusted\\ Documents\\\\TrustRecords.*") AND (registry_path = RGX(".*\\/AppData\\/Local\\/Microsoft\\/Windows\\/INetCache\\/.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\/AppData\\/Local\\/Temp\\/.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\/PerfLogs\\/.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*C\\:\\/Users\\/Public\\/.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*file\\:\\/\\/\\/D\\:\\/.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*file\\:\\/\\/\\/E\\:\\/.*")))
